settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.intro: For order-specific questions, send us a message through the contact page.

settings.question: How do I choose a size?
settings.answer: Select an available size on the product page. A detailed size guide will be added when final product specifications are confirmed.

settings.question: How can I tell if a product is available?
settings.answer: The product page reflects the currently selected variant and its live Shopify availability.

settings.question: Where can I review my cart?
settings.answer: Open the cart icon or visit the cart page to update quantities before checkout.

settings.question: How can I contact Handsome?
settings.answer: Use the contact form and include your order number if you already have one.
